title: Document Frontmatter Schema
description: Gate constraints that determine if content belongs in this document.

extends.description: Path to base JSON file to inherit from.

document_covers.description: Topics this document covers. If your content is NOT about these topics, DO NOT write here.

gate_constraints.description: Gate rules that determine if you can write in this document. Check ALL constraints before writing.

constraint_definitions.description: Gate constraint definitions. Check these BEFORE writing.

single_responsibility.description: This document covers exactly ONE topic. Before writing, verify your content is about the ONE topic defined in document_covers.
single_responsibility.gate_question: Is my content about the SINGLE topic this document covers?
single_responsibility.if_no: Find another document or create a new one

no_cross_references.description: This document cannot reference other internal documents by ID or filename.
no_cross_references.gate_question: Does my content need to link to other internal documents?
no_cross_references.if_yes: Either inline the content OR don't write here

no_duplicate_definitions.description: This document does not duplicate definitions that exist in schema files or type definitions.
no_duplicate_definitions.gate_question: Am I defining a structure that already exists in a schema/type file?
no_duplicate_definitions.if_yes: Don't write here. Reference the schema instead

no_duplicate_behavior.description: This document does not duplicate behavior already documented elsewhere.
no_duplicate_behavior.gate_question: Is this behavior/algorithm already documented in another file?
no_duplicate_behavior.if_yes: Don't write here. Content belongs in the original document

self_contained_content.description: This document must be understandable without reading other documents.
self_contained_content.gate_question: Can my content be understood without reading other docs?
self_contained_content.if_no: Either add context inline OR don't write here

index_document.description: Override: This is an index/README that catalogs other documents. Cross-references allowed.
